question: Priya had 33 marbles in her collection. Her cousin Dev had 20 fewer marbles than Priya. At a weekend tournament Dev won 15 more marbles, and the tournament lasted 4 hours. In the school marble league every marble a player owns is worth 8 points. Because it was finals week, the league tripled each player's points. How many league points did Dev end up with?

At the arcade Lena had 212 tokens. Her brother Marco had 8 times as many tokens as Lena. Marco then won 66 more tokens on the claw machine. The arcade is 6 miles from their house. At the prize booth every token Marco held was exchanged for 8 tickets, and afterwards he found 57 loose tickets on the floor and kept them. How many tickets did Marco have at the end?

A community garden started the season with 145 tomato seedlings. Nadia planted 66 more seedlings and Tariq planted 55, so Nadia planted more than Tariq. The garden is 30 metres long. Every seedling grew into a plant that produced 8 tomatoes, and a neighbour also gave the gardeners 71 tomatoes from her own vines. At the market every tomato the garden had was sold for 5 cents. How many cents did the garden take in?

In the morning Amir picked 150 apples and divided them equally into 3 baskets, keeping 1 basket for himself. His sister Bela had 6 times as many apples in her cart as Amir had in his basket. In the afternoon Bela sold every apple in her cart for 7 cents each. In the evening she found 46 more cents in her apron pocket and added them to her takings. How many cents did Bela have in the evening?

Kofi's phone had 133 photos on it. He deleted 17 blurry shots, then 35 duplicates, and then 62 old screenshots. The two friends went to a concert together, where Kofi took 65 new photos, and afterwards Ama sent him 36 photos she had taken that night. When they compared their phones, Ama had 6 times as many photos as Kofi. How many photos did Ama have?

The little theatre has 5 rows of 50 seats each. Before opening night 42 seats were found to be broken and removed, but the staff brought in 72 folding chairs to use as extra seats. Every seat was filled at each of the 7 sold-out performances. Each performance lasted 120 minutes, which the programme lists as two hours. The theatre is 40 years old. After the run, 252 tickets were refunded because of a billing error, and 15 extra standing tickets were sold at the door. How many paid tickets did the theatre end up with?

In the morning Sam started selling from a roll of 152 raffle tickets, and by noon he had sold 131 of them. In the afternoon 15 tickets got wet and were thrown away, and 3 more were torn. The organiser then let him swap each remaining ticket for 2 new ones, and gave him 44 loose tickets as well. In the evening Sam sold every ticket he had for 5 dollars each. How many dollars did Sam collect in the evening?

In the morning a quiz team had 191 points on the scoreboard. They lost 15 points for a late answer, and in the afternoon round they lost 140 points on a challenge they got wrong. The whole quiz ran for a single day. In the evening finale each remaining point was exchanged for 4 tokens, and each token could be traded for 5 raffle tickets. How many raffle tickets did the team receive?

A crew building a fence around a paddock laid 87 feet of fence in the first week. The foreman keeps his log in yards, and since every 3 feet make one yard, he wrote that week's length down in yards. The crew laid exactly the same length in each of the 7 weeks of the job. When the job was done the owner asked for the total in feet, so the foreman turned the yards back into feet. A storm then flattened 527 feet of the fence, and another 55 feet were taken down to fit a gate. How many feet of fence were left standing?

A print shop ran off 162 flyers on each of its 2 machines for the street fair. The manager added 61 flyers left over from last week's batch. The fair ran for 6 hours. Volunteers handed out 358 flyers during the fair, and 26 flyers were ruined by rain. How many flyers were left?

A small-town library kept 161 titles in its local-history collection. A retired teacher donated 22 more titles, an estate sale added 73 titles, and a grant paid for 78 more. The library then decided to hold 8 copies of every title in the collection. How many copies of local-history books did the library hold?

On Monday Ben counted 207 six-packs of soda in the shop's storeroom. On Tuesday his partner Dana brought in 79 more six-packs, and on Wednesday Ben brought in 64, so Dana had added more than Ben. Since every six-pack holds 6 cans, they switched to counting the stock in cans. Then they realised the count covered only 1 of the shop's 2 identical storerooms, and the other held exactly the same stock. Over the festival weekend the shop sold 1267 cans. How many cans were left in stock?

In the morning Ana brought 40 raffle tickets to the school fair, and her friend Ben brought 2 times as many tickets as Ana. Ben divided his tickets equally among 4 sellers, and Ana took one seller's batch to the gate. In the afternoon she sold every ticket in her batch for 5 dollars each, then refunded 57 dollars to a customer who had bought by mistake. The fair ran for 6 days, and Ana took in exactly that same amount every day. On the evening of the last day Ana and Ben shared her total takings equally between the 2 of them. How many dollars did Ana receive?

In the morning a parking garage had 162 cars in it. By mid-morning 33 more cars had arrived, and another 51 arrived during the afternoon. In the late afternoon 110 cars drove out. In the evening 93 more cars left. How many cars were in the garage at the end of the evening?

Eli put 117 coins into his savings jar in each of 3 months, which was more than his sister Faye managed to save. He then found 18 coins under the sofa and added them to the jar. Later he took 61 coins out to buy a comic. His parents then ran a matching scheme that left him with 2 coins in the jar for every coin he had. How many coins were in Eli's jar after the matching scheme?

A farm pressed 220 pints of cider and shared it equally between its 2 market stands. At Nora's stand 56 pints were spilled when a barrel tipped over. Nora serves cider by the cup, and since each pint fills 2 cups, she works out how many cups she has. Each cup sells for 3 dollars. A neighbouring stand then gave her 37 more cups of cider. How many cups of cider does Nora have to sell?

A bakery signed a contract to deliver bread to a hotel for 134 weeks. The hotel cancelled 43 of those weeks, then later extended the contract by 6 weeks. The bakery's scheduler counts in days rather than weeks, and since a week has 7 days, she wrote the contract length down in days. Each delivery van carries 500 loaves. So far 648 delivery days have been completed, 28 delivery days fall on public holidays with no delivery, and 2 days were lost to a snowstorm. How many delivery days remain?

Vic's corner shop had 127 six-packs of juice, but sold 118 of them over the holiday weekend. Since a six-pack holds 6 cans, Vic counted what was left in cans. His rival Wen, whose shop is across the street, had 6 times as many cans of juice as Vic. Wen then received a delivery of 76 more cans. How many cans of juice did Wen have?

Sofia started the arcade game with 90 points and picked up 38 more points on the first level. A bonus mushroom then doubled her score. On the next level every point she had was worth 6 points, and on the final level every point she had was then worth 9 points. How many points did Sofia finish the game with?

In the morning Cara's farm stall had 240 strawberries, all from a single crate, and she added 37 more that she picked before opening. In the afternoon she sold 103 strawberries and threw out 28 that had gone soft. In the evening her brother Dan counted his own stall and found he had 9 times as many strawberries as Cara. Dan then picked 56 more strawberries before closing. How many strawberries did Dan have at the end of the evening?

Maya's memory card held 202 photos from her trip. She deleted 172 blurry ones and then took 3 more of the sunset. At the print shop she ordered 9 prints of every photo left on the card. She added 65 prints from an older trip to the same album box, and later threw away 11 prints that were creased. How many prints were in the album box?

In the morning each of the 122 cows on a dairy farm gave 7 pints of milk. In the afternoon the farmer tallied that the whole day's milking came to 5 times the morning amount. There are 5 farms in the co-op, each produced exactly the same amount that day, and the co-op kept up that daily total for 9 days in a row. In the evening of the last day the bottler asked for the total in cups, and since each pint is 2 cups, the manager converted it. How many cups of milk did the co-op produce over the 9 days?

Jun scored 193 points in the opening round of the tournament, more than his teammate Kim. A power-up then tripled his score. In the second round every point he held was worth 6 points, in the third round every point was worth 5 points, and in the fourth round every point was worth 5 points again. The tournament rule is that a player's final score is shared equally among the 6 members of his team. How many points did Jun receive from his own final score?

Rosa bought 74 tulip bulbs, then went back to the garden centre and bought the same again, so that she had double the bulbs. The flower bed is 4 metres long. When she opened the bags she found 5 bulbs had rotted and threw them out. Every bulb she planted sent up 3 blooms, and she sold every bloom for 6 cents each. How many cents did Rosa make from the blooms?

Ivy had 78 stickers in her album. Her classmate Jake gave her 13 of his, which meant Ivy now had more stickers than Jake. Ivy then gave 51 stickers to a couple of her cousins, lost 20 when her bag got wet, and traded 14 away at school. Finally 1 sticker tore and had to be thrown out. How many stickers did Ivy have left?
